title: School Life (学校生活)
description: Talk about school in Mandarin: subjects, timetables and 上课/下课, school facilities, stationery, comparing subjects with 比 (bǐ), and saying what you like most with 最 (zuì).

notes.heading: 📌 School Subjects (课程)
notes.body:
School subjects are 课 (kè) or 课程 (kèchéng). Here are the most common ones:

| Chinese | Pinyin | English |
|---|---|---|
| 中文 / 汉语 | Zhōngwén / Hànyǔ | Chinese |
| 数学 | shùxué | maths |
| 科学 | kēxué | science |
| 英语 | Yīngyǔ | English |
| 体育 | tǐyù | PE |
| 音乐 | yīnyuè | music |
| 美术 | měishù | art |
| 历史 | lìshǐ | history |
| 地理 | dìlǐ | geography |

Example: 我们今天有数学课。 (Wǒmen jīntiān yǒu shùxué kè.) — We have maths today.

notes.heading: 🔑 Class Time: 上课 and 下课
notes.body:
上课 (shàngkè) means "class begins / to attend class" and 下课 (xiàkè) means "class ends". 上 means "up / start" and 下 means "down / finish" — the same pair you see in 上学 (go to school) and 放学 (school lets out).

- 我们八点半上课。 (Wǒmen bā diǎn bàn shàngkè.) — We start class at half past eight.
- 三点下课。 (Sān diǎn xiàkè.) — Class finishes at three o'clock.

A timetable is 课程表 (kèchéngbiǎo). To say which lesson it is, use 第 (dì) + number + 节课: 第一节课 is the first lesson, 第三节课 is the third lesson.

Example: 我们上午有四节课。 (Wǒmen shàngwǔ yǒu sì jié kè.) — We have four lessons in the morning.

notes.heading: 📌 School Facilities (学校设施)
notes.body:
Learn the places around your school:

| Chinese | Pinyin | English |
|---|---|---|
| 教室 | jiàoshì | classroom |
| 图书馆 | túshūguǎn | library |
| 操场 | cāochǎng | playground / sports field |
| 食堂 | shítáng | canteen / dining hall |
| 办公室 | bàngōngshì | office |
| 体育馆 | tǐyùguǎn | gym / sports hall |

Notice 馆 (guǎn) appears in 图书馆 and 体育馆 — it often marks a public building or hall.

Example: 下课以后，我们去操场打球。 (Xiàkè yǐhòu, wǒmen qù cāochǎng dǎ qiú.) — After class, we go to the sports field to play ball.

notes.heading: 📌 Stationery (文具)
notes.body:
Stationery is 文具 (wénjù). These are the things in your pencil case and schoolbag:

| Chinese | Pinyin | English |
|---|---|---|
| 铅笔 | qiānbǐ | pencil |
| 钢笔 | gāngbǐ | (fountain) pen |
| 橡皮 | xiàngpí | eraser / rubber |
| 尺子 | chǐzi | ruler |
| 书包 | shūbāo | schoolbag |
| 本子 | běnzi | notebook |
| 课本 | kèběn | textbook |

笔 (bǐ) means a writing tool, so it appears in 铅笔 (lead-pen = pencil) and 钢笔 (steel-pen = pen).

The measure word for pens and pencils is 支 (zhī): 一支铅笔 (one pencil), 两支钢笔 (two pens).

Example: 我的书包里有一本课本和两支铅笔。 (Wǒ de shūbāo li yǒu yì běn kèběn hé liǎng zhī qiānbǐ.) — In my schoolbag there is a textbook and two pencils.

notes.heading: 🔑 Comparing with 比 (bǐ)
notes.body:
To compare two things, use 比 (bǐ), which works like "than".

Pattern: A 比 B + adjective.

- 数学比英语难。 (Shùxué bǐ Yīngyǔ nán.) — Maths is harder than English.
- 中文比英文有意思。 (Zhōngwén bǐ Yīngwén yǒu yìsi.) — Chinese is more interesting than English.

⚠️ Common mistake: do not add 很 (hěn) after 比. 数学比英语很难 is wrong — the comparison already says "more", so just say 数学比英语难. To say "even more", use 更 (gèng): 数学比英语更难。 (Maths is even harder than English.)

notes.heading: 🔑 The Most: 最 (zuì)
notes.body:
最 (zuì) means "the most" and goes before an adjective or a verb like 喜欢 (to like).

- 我最喜欢体育课。 (Wǒ zuì xǐhuan tǐyù kè.) — I like PE the most.
- 最难的课是数学。 (Zuì nán de kè shì shùxué.) — The most difficult subject is maths.
- 谁最高? (Shéi zuì gāo?) — Who is the tallest?

比 compares two things (A is more X than B); 最 picks out number one from a group (A is the most X). Compare: 音乐比美术有意思。 (Music is more interesting than art.) vs 音乐最有意思。 (Music is the most interesting.)

notes.heading: 💡 Describing Your School Day
notes.body:
People at school: 老师 (lǎoshī) teacher, 学生 (xuésheng) student, 同学 (tóngxué) classmate.

Model paragraph:

我在一所中学上学。我们每天八点半上课，三点半下课。上午有四节课，下午有两节课。我最喜欢的课是体育，因为很有意思。我觉得数学比英语难。下课以后，我常常和同学去操场打球。

(Wǒ zài yì suǒ zhōngxué shàngxué. Wǒmen měitiān bā diǎn bàn shàngkè, sān diǎn bàn xiàkè. Shàngwǔ yǒu sì jié kè, xiàwǔ yǒu liǎng jié kè. Wǒ zuì xǐhuan de kè shì tǐyù, yīnwèi hěn yǒu yìsi. Wǒ juéde shùxué bǐ Yīngyǔ nán. Xiàkè yǐhòu, wǒ chángcháng hé tóngxué qù cāochǎng dǎ qiú.)

"I go to a secondary school. We start class at 8:30 and finish at 3:30 every day. There are four lessons in the morning and two in the afternoon. My favourite subject is PE because it is fun. I think maths is harder than English. After class, I often play ball with my classmates on the sports field."

✅ Check: can you say when your classes start and finish, which subject you like most, and compare two subjects with 比?

flashcards.example: 数学比英语难。 — Maths is harder than English.
我最喜欢体育课。 — I like PE the most.

flashcards.definition: to begin class; to attend class
flashcards.example: 我们八点半上课。 — We start class at half past eight.
下课以后我们去操场。 — After class we go to the sports field.
我在图书馆看书。 — I read books in the library.
同学们在操场上打球。 — The students are playing ball on the sports field.
我有一支新铅笔。 — I have a new pencil.
借我一下橡皮，好吗? — Lend me your eraser, OK?
我的书包很重。 — My schoolbag is very heavy.
中文比英文有意思。 — Chinese is more interesting than English.
最难的课是数学。 — The hardest subject is maths.
我和同学一起做作业。 — I do homework together with my classmates.

questions.stem: 数学 (shùxué) is which school subject?
questions.explanation: 数学 (shùxué) means maths. 数 means number, so it is the subject of numbers.

questions.stem: 图书馆 (túshūguǎn) is which place in a school?
questions.explanation: 图书馆 (túshūguǎn) is the library — 图书 means books and 馆 marks a public building. The gym is 体育馆.
下 means down/finish, so 下课 (xiàkè) means class ends. 上课 (shàngkè) is the opposite — class begins.

questions.stem: 我们每天八点上课。 What does this sentence mean?
choices: We finish class at eight every day.
We start class at eight every day.
We have eight classes every day.
We go to school at eight tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 上课 (shàngkè) means class begins and 每天 means every day, so the sentence says we start class at eight every day.

questions.stem: 铅笔 (qiānbǐ) is which item of stationery?
questions.explanation: 铅笔 (qiānbǐ) is a pencil — 铅 means lead and 笔 is a writing tool. A (fountain) pen is 钢笔 (gāngbǐ).

questions.stem: Fill in the gap: 我有一___铅笔。 (I have one pencil.)
questions.explanation: Pens and pencils are counted with 支 (zhī): 一支铅笔 is one pencil. 间 counts rooms and 双 counts pairs.

questions.stem: Which sentence correctly says "Maths is harder than English"?
questions.explanation: The pattern is A 比 B + adjective: 数学 (maths) 比 (than) 英语 (English) 难 (hard). Adding 很 after 比 is a common mistake, and swapping A and B reverses the meaning.

questions.stem: 我最喜欢体育课。 What does this mean?
choices: I have PE the most often.
questions.explanation: 最 (zuì) before 喜欢 (to like) means "like the most", so the sentence says I like PE the most — it is my favourite.

questions.stem: Where would students go to 打球 (play ball) at school?
questions.explanation: 操场 (cāochǎng) is the playground or sports field, the outdoor area where students play sports and ball games.
同学 (tóngxué) literally means "same-study" — someone who studies with you, a classmate. A teacher is 老师 (lǎoshī).

questions.stem: How do you say "The most difficult subject is science" in Chinese?
questions.explanation: 最 goes directly before the adjective: 最难的课 (the most difficult subject) 是 (is) 科学 (science).

questions.stem: 我们上午有四节课。 What does this sentence mean?
choices: We have four lessons in the morning.
We have four lessons in the afternoon.
Our fourth lesson is in the morning.
We finish school at four in the morning.
questions.explanation: 上午 (shàngwǔ) is morning and 四节课 is four lessons, so the sentence says we have four lessons in the morning.

questions.stem: 我的书包里有五本书和两支铅笔。 What is in the schoolbag?
questions.explanation: 五本书 is five books (本 counts books) and 两支铅笔 is two pencils (支 counts pens and pencils), so the bag holds five books and two pencils.

questions.stem: What is an 橡皮 (xiàngpí) used for?
questions.explanation: 橡皮 (xiàngpí) is an eraser (rubber), used to rub out pencil marks. A ruler for measuring is 尺子 (chǐzi).

questions.stem: Which sentence says "Today we have Chinese, maths and PE"?
choices: 今天我们有中文、数学和体育。
今天我们有英语、科学和体育。
明天我们有中文、数学和体育。
今天我们没有中文、数学和体育。
questions.explanation: 今天是 today, 有 is have, and 中文、数学和体育 are Chinese, maths and PE joined by 和 (and). The other options change the subjects, the day, or make it negative.
